methods.name: lighten
methods.description: Lighten the color a given amount. Providing 100 will always return white.

methods.name: brighten
methods.description: Brighten the color a given amount, from 0 to 100.

methods.name: darken
methods.description:
Darken the color a given amount, from 0 to 100.
Providing 100 will always return black.

methods.name: tint
methods.description:
Mix the color with pure white, from 0 to 100.
Providing 0 will do nothing, providing 100 will always return white.

methods.name: shade
methods.description:
Mix the color with pure black, from 0 to 100.
Providing 0 will do nothing, providing 100 will always return black.

methods.name: desaturate
methods.description:
Desaturate the color a given amount, from 0 to 100.
Providing 100 will is the same as calling greyscale

methods.name: saturate
methods.description: Saturate the color a given amount, from 0 to 100.

methods.name: greyscale
methods.description:
Completely desaturates a color into greyscale.
Same as calling `desaturate(100)`

methods.name: spin
methods.description:
Spin takes a positive or negative amount within [-360, 360] indicating the change of hue.
Values outside of this range will be wrapped into this range.

methods.name: mix
methods.description:
Mix the current color a given amount with another color, from 0 to 100.
0 means no mixing (return current color).

methods.name: analogous
methods.description: Executes `analogous` to handle analogous.

methods.name: complement
methods.description: Executes `complement` to handle complement.

methods.name: monochromatic
methods.description: Executes `monochromatic` to handle monochromatic.

methods.name: splitcomplement
methods.description: Executes `splitcomplement` to handle splitcomplement.

methods.name: triad
methods.description: Executes `triad` to handle triad.

methods.name: tetrad
methods.description: Executes `tetrad` to handle tetrad.

methods.name: polyad
methods.description:
Get polyad colors, like (for 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, etc...)
monad, dyad, triad, tetrad, pentad, hexad, heptad, octad, etc...
